decision.S_role: Retain causal M5/M15/H1/H4/D1 dynamic S as a separate market-state forecast and context. Do not convert future certified S side into an Entry action.
decision.active_S_comparison: Prebind all 25 query/timeframe cells, activity/conditional-side/three-class proper scores, same-row persistence and earlier-TRAIN per-cell prior. Evaluate the complete fixed later development cohort in issue-time order with paired UTC-week uncertainty. No later score selects a cell, weight or checkpoint; a better S score is not Entry Edge.
decision.active_S_hypothesis: On the fixed five-point path for each of M5/M15/H1/H4/D1, the causal full-GC/XAU model improves proper probabilities over a per-cell prior fitted only on earlier mature TRAIN. Unknown activity and side remain separately masked. Fold2 is one development gate; supported folds 1-4 need their own prefix-valid input normalization for chronological OOF.
decision.later_entry_comparison: Fit and any threshold only on earlier mature TRAIN. Score the fixed later 4096 development rows in time order against frozen TRAIN prior and predeclared always-LONG/always-SHORT/FLAT references on identical observable populations. Report all six horizons, selected and abstained rows, coverage, weekly uncertainty, costs and open-position limitations. No horizon or threshold selection from later scores.
decision.later_entry_hypothesis: Earlier mature Fold2 causal XAU+full-GC five-TF inputs contain incremental information about both LONG and SHORT M5 cost-adjusted terminal markout and conservative pre-MFE MAE on the six fixed observation horizons, beyond an earlier-fit frozen constant prior.
decision.later_entry_target_scope: Keep all physical M5 decision rows and both executable sides. Use separate terminal and complete-path observation masks and the existing causal price/cost authority; do not use future S labels or future availability as model input.

next_gate: Bind one exact S-only five-TF 25-cell loss and earlier-TRAIN per-cell prior, qualify S-specific optimizer/resume and prefix-valid chronological Fold2/later scoring, then seek a separate exact fit admission. Entry heads remain inactive in this phase. Extend to supported folds 1-4 only with their own prefix-valid normalization. TEST, broker and trading stay closed.

phase_order_correction.meaning: The measured direct-S and all-side Entry economics remain valid research evidence, but their model fit and decision policy belong after the active S learning phase. The dual-head B16 control was read-only mechanics, not a combined-objective admission.

reuse_candidate.existing_decoder: The existing entry_only_dynamic_m5_path decoder already has a shared 1..480 minute query, two-side terminal-net, MFE and conservative pre-MFE-MAE outputs. All six fixed observation points are in its query grid. Reuse is a source candidate only; the Fold2 S task and this Entry model have different target and cohort bindings.
